# picohttpparser

Upstream: https://github.com/h2o/picohttpparser
Revision: f4d94b48b31e0abae029ebeafcfd9ca0680ede58

The C source and header are unmodified upstream files, used under the MIT license
included in both files. The gateway uses the incremental chunked-body decoder;
framing headers, authorization, body limits and cancellation remain gateway policy.
